page_title: Esen Tunalı Sarı — Founder & Creative Director
meta_description: Discover the personal story of Esen Tunalı Sarı, the software developer and creative director harmonising artificial intelligence with bespoke jewellery design at SILVER & ELEGANT.
heading: The Creative Technologist

sections.label: My story
sections.body:
I was born in Ruse, Bulgaria, a city on the Danube where the architecture carries the memory of every era that passed through it. Baroque facades, Soviet concrete, and the river itself, indifferent, enduring, older than all of it.

  

The Nobel Prize winning author Elias Canetti was born there. He once wrote: "Anything I subsequently experienced had already happened in Ruschuk." I understand what he meant.

  

When I was a child, my family moved to Istanbul and settled in Bakırköy. Our neighbours were almost entirely silversmiths and jewellers, many of them working daily in the Grand Bazaar, a market that has operated continuously for more than five centuries and remains one of the world’s oldest and largest centres of jewellery craftsmanship. I grew up surrounded by that work, not as a visitor to it, but as someone who saw it practised next door every day as an ordinary part of life.

sections.label: Design Philosophy
sections.body:
Our process is rooted in the synthesis of architectural precision and traditional craftsmanship. We engage in classical design and artisanal production within our Istanbul atelier, bringing complex structural forms into reality through the hands of a master.

It is in this balance — where digital intent meets human touch and the language of metal — that we find the signature permanence of SILVER & ELEGANT.

We operate at the intersection of architectural minimalism and narrative jewellery. In a world of disposable consumption, SILVER & ELEGANT stands for the philosophy of Future Heirlooms — objects crafted with the intent to outlast the fleeting moment of their creation, designed to be passed down through generations.
sections.label: Brand Vision

sections.body:
The brand's emergence was marked by our participation as a jewellery partner for Paul Costelloe's Autumn/Winter 2026 opening show. This milestone represents a significant step in our commitment to bringing high-concept, architectural jewellery into contemporary fashion.

As a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA), my practice is defined by a dedication to design discipline, cultural heritage, and the continuous search for intellectual depth in aesthetic production.
